notes.title: Patch 1.5.1
notes.notes:
Improvements:
- Added a bit more invulnerability time when loading a save file, preventing being instakilled if saving on low health at a bad spot
- Minor tweaks on several levels

Bug fixes:
- Fixed weapon wheel that would sometimes incorrectly black out weapons
- Fixed E2M5 "Searing Sun"'s secret chest that would not open
- Fixed ammo count not sometimes not showing the inifinite sign when having infinite ammo
- Fixed a bug where all episode 3 levels were unlocked without having to do any progress

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0 - New content and major improvements!
notes.notes:
Happy first anniversary to Herald of Havoc! To celebrate this special occasion, I'm releasing a new patch containing major visual upgrades, enhanced sound effects, a new enemy type for survival mode, and an entirely new level! 
I hope you'll enjoy it :) 
- Zeldars

New:

- Added a little bit of spice in E3M4 - Cursed Town 
- Added a new enemy in survival mode (more info in the survival section) 
- Added a new level: the Military Zone 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42252927/881e2ecb34bf871f48ba947ecf4f3628d2b286a0.png

This level will replace the current E1M2, the latter is still playable in the "Extra Levels" menu 

Improvements: 

- Weapons got a visual update! Here's some examples for comparison (new visuals are on the right):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42252927/bb6991113a5f2b307cea053d7b2518254ccd7556.jpg

- All enemies got a visual update! Again, here are some comparisons:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42252927/ae85dd68ca39017904e7de532f38439a8bd6e267.jpg

- Some levels got a visual update and E1M1's gameplay has been tweaked a little bit 
- You can now visibly see the guards holding the keys in E3M1 - Hide and Seek 
- Lower tier enemies now have more sound effects when killed 
- Bullet based weapons sound more impactful when hitting enemies 
- You can now delete a save file by pressing 'Del' on the keyboard 
- You can now visibly see cracks on Skeleton, Metal Colossus, and drone when they are badly damaged 

Survival mode: 

- Endless mode renamed to Survival mode 
- Added a new special enemy for survival mode: The Unstable drone! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42252927/5f0cab8a1305e1a6e6131f42ea2cfa72473a69dd.png

It's like a regular drone... except it explodes when killed, dealing big damage to enemies while you don't take any damage from its explosion! It's like a flying explosive barrel. Enemies hit by the explosion take full damage regardless of the distance between them and the explosion 

Balance changes: 

- Metal Colossus's homing projectiles now disappear a little bit faster 

Bug fixes: 

- Fixed the jump keybind not being rebindable 
- Fixed a bug where you could pick up an health pickup while at 100 HP 
- Fixed a bug in E3M4 where entering the pool of blood would sometimes make you bounce 
- Fixed a bug where the Shotgun's muzzle flash would stay on forever

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
- Fixed your velocity's being off when you exit a teleporter
- Fixed a soft lock location in E1M5
- Fixed a 2% chance that a specter would spawn out of bounds in E1M3 in Havoc difficulty
- Fixed a problem where the Heavy soldier in E1M6 in Havoc difficulty, would spawn out of bounds or in the wrong place
- Added killing triggers in out of bound places
- Other small corrections

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Improvements:
- You no longer instantly shoot just after clicking on a save slot

Bug fixes:
- Loading from a quicksave no longer auto deletes the save, so you can now load multiple times from the same quicksave
- When running to an elevator: you will now snap on to it instead of doing a mini-jump
- Adding missing faces on an elevator in E1M2
- Leprechauns no longer shoot you in endless mode

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Here's a patch with most of the requested features as well as adding a bit of my own spice here and there... Enjoy!
-Zeldars

New:
- Added "Brightness" setting
- Added "Quicksave" and "Quickload" keybinds
- Added "Toggle FPS count" keybind
- Added "Toggle HUD" keybind

Improvements:
- Improved visuals when firing with the Havoc powerup: Blue fireballs, blue explosions, new muzzle flashes, and more!
- The Chaingun will now get hot and smoke when firing continously! This doesn't affect gameplay
- Updated several particles effects
- The platforms in E2M3's blue zone are now longer
- Added some particle effects in E3M1's machine room
- The mouse control is now a bit more responsive, less floaty.
- Added some invulnerability frames when loading a game: no more insta death on bad saves!
- Setting a keybind that's already used elsewhere will now set the other keybind to 'none' and a warning will be shown

Balance Changes:
- You will now receive a bit less self damage from your own explosions, except for the Shock rifle's secondary
- Flame Cannon's rate of fire increased by 12.5%
- Chaingun's explosive mode rate of fire increased by 12%

Bug fixes:
- Fixed some enemies that could get stuck in E1M4
- Fixed a possibility to get soft locked in E1M4
- Fixed a softlock spot in E2M4
- Fixed a bug in E1M4 where it was difficult to re enter the castle
- Fixed a bug in E3M1 where a Pyro could kill you from the machine room
- Fixed a bug in E3M1 where an enemy could rarely go through the floor when crushed by a door
- Fixed a bug in E3M5 where you could go out of bounds

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Balance Changes:
- You can now switch more quickly to another weapon after firing
- Flamethrower's primary fire damage reduced by 22%
- Flamethrower's primary fire burn duration slightly reduced

Misc:
- Added ambience sounds in most of the maps
- You can now climb the pyramid in E2M6
- TAB now shows precise enemy kill count instead of a percentage
- Added muzzle flash on hitscan enemies
- While noclipping: You can now press Left-Alt to go faster and left-Shift to go slower

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where picking Akimbo or Havoc powerup while using the Blaster's special ability would cancel the powerup
- Fixed E1M4's possibility to get soft-locked at the beginning on Havoc difficulty
- Fixed Shotgun hurting yourself when under the slowmo powerup
- Fixed E3M4's skeletons not being killable with the runeblade

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Blaster Update
notes.notes:
The blaster got updated! featuring a brand new look on the primary fire, and way more damage per shot at the cost of a slower fire rate. The secondary and special ability are unchanged.

Balance Changes:
- Blaster's primary fire damage increased by 150%
- Blaster's primary fire projectile speed increased
- Blaster's primary fire time between shots increased: 0.2s -> 0.3s

Misc: 
- Added "Reset to default" buttons in the settings menu

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
New:
- You can now see the kill count when pressing TAB

Mics:
- Added an explosive ammo pack in E1M6 - Ghost Town

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't have 100% kills in E1M6 - Ghost Town when played on veteran difficulty

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
New:
- Added "Completionist" steam achievements for episode 2 and 3

Misc:
- In E2M8. The red key is now pickable without having to kill a Dark hunter: This is intended to resolve a rare instance where you could be softlocked.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where you would respawn in the previous level that occured when you manually saved at the end of the previous level, and you died before an autosave in the current level

notes.title: Patch 0.19.0 - Last patch before launch
notes.notes:
This is it... this may be the last patch before launching the full game. E3M3, E3M4, and E3M5 will all be available at the same time in version 1.0.

Small corrective patches are still to be expected if I hear about major bugs or problems.

Thanks everyone for being there, enjoying the early access and giving feedback! I'll see you in about a month, for the full release :)

- Zeldars

Misc:
- Added a bit more health pickups in most of the levels

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a spot in E2M3 where you could get soft locked
- Fixed Powerfists not automatically stuning enemies on hit

notes.title: Patch 0.11.1
notes.notes:
New
- Added a secret menu
- Added an achievement

Misc
- Rebalanced the volume of some sound effects

Balance Changes
Blaster's special ability has been nerfed as it was completly destroying even the most beefy enemies under a second which is too much for a starting weapon, even after the nerf it will still be the highest single target DPS weapon, but not by a huge margin anymore
- Damage of Blaster's projectiles under the special ability reduced 40 -> 26
- Duration of Blaster's the special ability reduced 9s -> 7s

Buffing the Blaster's secondary fire will make it's niche stronger as a burn damage spreader
- Duration of Blaster's secondary fire burn increased by 150%

Nerfing the Flamethrower's burn duration will make you more reliable on the actual flames instead of the damage over time
- Duration of Flamethrower's burn decreased by 25%

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug when using the Chaingun's secondary fire while having the akimbo powerup
- Fixed a problem at the beginning area of E2M5 that got you stuck if you go backwards

- Screen shake amount setting can now have 'Off', 'Low', 'High' values instead of just 'On' and 'Off'

Balance changes:

- Increased Flamethrower's hitbox radius

Misc:

notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2

notes.title: Patch 0.8.2
notes.notes:
A small update before I go back to making campaign levels :)

Misc:
- Improved Runeblade's impact VFX
- Improved Blaster's impact VFX
- Firing the Shock Rifle on water now instantly deals damage to enemies in water (previously had a delay before doing damage)
- Treasure chest's light now match the rarity of the loot

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where you sometimes couldn't use your weapon after Akimbo ends
- Fixed a bug where some weapons didn't aim properly while having Akimbo and Slow Time at the same time

notes.title: Patch 0.8.1
notes.notes:
New
- Added 2 new achievements

Misc
- Reworked endless mode spawn algorithm to make each waves feel more unique

- In Endless - Black Fortress: Passage that you can unlock with energy cells are more visible

Bug fixes
- Fixed flammethrower's fire being off center

notes.title: Patch 0.8.0 - The Black Fortress
notes.notes:
This update enhances the endless mode with new spawn patterns, new weapons, and a new map that make every run feels very different!

New:
- New endless map! Endless - Black Fortress: A more complex endless map where you pickup energy cells to open doors or activate traps! A treasure chest also appears in a random location every game, giving you a free weapon every round! Better look for it!
- New weapons on endless mode!
- Added new spawn patterns to endless mode

Misc:
- Firing the Shock Rifle on water now electrocutes everything that touches the water for MASSIVE DAMAGE
- Increased the likeability to spawn a melee enemy in endless mode

Bug fixes:
